title: Neko Ashi Dachi
body:
Syntax: neko ashi dachi

Description: A stance granting +2 hit roll and 4 points of Armor Class protection. Only one stance can be active; switch or leave it outside combat. Using the current stance again ends it. The stance persists through reconnects. Taijutsu unlocks at level 15. Costs 0 Chakra and 12 Stamina; 0 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
